name: Spain national team 2008-12
scopeNote: Spain national team from the Euro 2008 opener (10 June 2008, v Russia) to the Euro 2012 final (1 July 2012). Euro 2008 under Luis Aragones (spell cut at the 29 June 2008 final); World Cup 2010 and Euro 2012 under Vicente del Bosque (appointed 15 July 2008 per search summary of Wikipedia-derived page, first match 20 Aug 2008 per RFEF summary; neither date verified on a mined page). Style named by sources: possession game / toque de balon (Aragones, Del Bosque kept it); popular label tiki-taka is used loosely by press, Del Bosque said the players were not tiki-taka Talibans (search summary only). Euro 2012 shape is often called 4-6-0 (Football Espana) but FourFourTwo argues the final was not 4-6-0. No Barcelona club matches and no 2013 Confederations Cup or 2014 World Cup events used. Marking, pressing triggers and build-up detail are thin in readable sources.
openQuestions: Del Bosque appointment date (11 March 2008 announced, 15 July 2008 confirmed) not verified on a mined page
Aragones to Del Bosque handover: Aragones left after the 29 June 2008 final; exact contract end not verified
Pressing, marking (zonal vs man) and build-up for the 2010 side lack a readable tier A-B source
UEFA pages for Euro 2008 squad selection were not accessible
